text:
Leah (PM): Need a crisp selection rubric + feedback plan for the private pilot. Goal: actionable signals for roadmap without overcommitting infra.

Sam (GTM): Propose a 5-field scorecard (0-3 each): business impact, infra readiness, compliance need, engagement bandwidth, revenue potential. Auto-sort by total.

Ravi (Eng): Add ops risk flag for on-prem installs. If flagged, reserve extra SE hours.

Nora (SE): Capture a one-line baseline metric (p95 latency or cost per inference) and the primary success metric to measure impact.

Eli (CS): Incentive idea: $5k credit or co-marketing spot. Require a technical contact + business sponsor in the form.

Leah (PM): Form fields (short): company, contact, technical contact, sponsor, baseline metric, routes to migrate, video (2min), scorecard answers, ops risk flag, primary metric.

Sam (GTM): Outreach skeleton: Subject: Join Redwood Private Pilot — limited seats. Quick 5-min form + 2-min workflow video.

Ravi (Eng): Telemetry policy: collect aggregated latency histograms, per-route token counts, optional sampled outputs (opt-in). Allow logs exported to customer S3 with KMS. Consent checkbox required.

Nora (SE): Feedback cadence: two 30-min standups in first 2 weeks, then weekly 60-min working sessions + office hours. Partners fill a 5-question quickform weekly.

Leah (PM): We'll send a weekly "signal pack": perf snapshot, prompt-regressions, open issues. PDF to all sponsors.

Sam (GTM): Timeline: open invites Tue -> form open 10 days -> shortlist -> kickoff two weeks after close. Target: 12 invites -> 6 accept -> 4 starters.

Eli (CS): Onboarding checklist (gates): account connect, baseline eval run, sample integration, perf dashboard access, SE intro.

Ravi (Eng): Baseline eval command (repo): `redwood-eval --suite pilot-quick --routes routes.json --out baseline.json`. Make it mandatory before onboarding session.

Leah (PM): Success criteria: 4 orgs active within 2 weeks, median p95 meets SLO for 85% of routes, at least 3 actionable product asks surfaced, pilot NPS >= 6 at week 6.

Nora (SE): Risks & mitigations: scope creep -> explicit OOS doc + paid consulting offer; infra failures -> reserve sandboxes + rollback runbook; privacy -> telemetry opt-out + KMS.

Action items:
- Sam: form + outreach draft by EOD Wed
- Ravi: eval CLI + telemetry text by Thu
- Nora: onboarding checklist + playbook by Thu
- Eli: incentive copy + sponsor comms by Thu
- Leah: finalize rubric and publish invite list once responses land

invite-bot: Reminder set for 1809994380 (ping #product)

Sam (GTM): I'll post the outreach draft here when ready.

Leah (PM): Thanks team — concise asks in the form is key to avoid drop-off :thumbsup:
